reference: AH-1G HueyCobra: TM 55-1520-221-10 cockpit figures (pilot and gunner instrument panels, controls); vietnamhelicopters.org AH-1 variant table (AH-1G sights: M73 reflex sight for the pilot, XM28 turret pantograph sight for the gunner). Pilot (rear): 1960s steam-gauge panel, centre cyclic, collective on the left with the twist-grip throttle (single T53), M73 rocket sight on the coaming; gunner (front): basic flight instruments, pantograph-mounted reflex sight with two handgrips in the middle, side-arm cyclic on the right console and side-arm collective on the left
